gold: Inflammation-induced ocular neuropathy associated with SARS-CoV-2–induced panuveitis

selector.why: The presence of severe bilateral pneumonia, recent close contact with a fatal case, and positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2, along with the specific ocular findings such as central scotoma and fluorescein leakage from retinal venules, decided it.
